title: Sample Quiz — How This Works
description: A short demo set showing all three question types.
subject: rla

questions.prompt: Which layer of the study philosophy covers the individual question you're practicing right now?

options.whyWrong: Plans are broader goals and direction, not the single question directly in front of you.
Systems are repeated routines or habits, not the individual item you are answering right now.
One of these does fit: the question itself belongs to the details layer.

questions.explanation: Details are the sharp end of the plan — the specific thing in front of you right now.
questions.rule: The “details” layer is the immediate task in front of you—the exact question or passage you are working on right now.

questions.prompt: A repeated habit that carries you toward your goal without relying on motivation is called a ______.
questions.explanation: That's the 'Systems' layer — routines you can run on autopilot.

questions.prompt: In a sentence or two, describe one system (habit or routine) you could build for your own studying.
questions.explanation: Open-ended answers aren't auto-graded — this is for your own reflection, or for a teacher to review manually.
